totem.meaning: an animal or object taken as a tribe's emblem, often carved on a pole

tough.meaning: strong and hard to break; difficult

trace.meaning: find by following clues; a tiny amount

trail.meaning: a path; to follow; to lag behind

trawl.meaning: fish by dragging a net; search thoroughly

treat.meaning: something special that gives pleasure; to behave towards

trial.meaning: a court hearing; a test of something

troll.meaning: a mythical ugly creature; someone who posts to provoke online

trout.meaning: a freshwater fish related to salmon

trunk.meaning: a tree's main stem; an elephant's nose; a large box

tulip.meaning: a spring flower with a cup-shaped bloom

turbo.meaning: short for turbocharger: a device that gives an engine extra power

twist.meaning: turn or wind around; an unexpected turn in a story

twixt.meaning: old or poetic form of betwixt: between
twixt.example: twixt the cup and the lip

ulcer.meaning: an open sore on the skin or inside the body

until.meaning: up to the point in time or the event mentioned

upset.meaning: unhappy or worried; to knock over
upset.example: she was upset by the news

valet.meaning: a person who parks cars at a hotel or restaurant; a personal servant

value.meaning: how much something is worth or matters

valve.meaning: a device that controls flow through a pipe

vault.meaning: a secure room for valuables; to leap over

verse.meaning: a group of lines in a poem or song; poetry

vicar.meaning: a parish priest in the Church of England

vigil.meaning: staying awake to keep watch or pray

villa.meaning: a large, often luxurious house, especially a holiday one

vinyl.meaning: a plastic used for records and flooring; a record

viola.meaning: a string instrument slightly larger than a violin

viral.meaning: spread by a virus; spreading quickly online

virus.meaning: a tiny germ that causes disease; a harmful computer program

waltz.meaning: a graceful ballroom dance in three-time

watch.meaning: look at attentively; a small clock worn on the wrist

water.meaning: the clear liquid that falls as rain and fills rivers and seas

wedge.meaning: a piece thick at one end and thin at the other

whale.meaning: a huge sea mammal that breathes through a blowhole

wheat.meaning: the grain ground into flour for bread and roti

which.meaning: asking or specifying one out of a set

whine.meaning: complain in an annoying voice; a high-pitched cry

whisk.meaning: beat eggs or cream quickly; the tool for it

would.meaning: past of will: used for imagined situations, wishes and polite requests

wrack.meaning: destruction, in 'wrack and ruin'; also seaweed

wring.meaning: twist and squeeze to force out liquid

wrote.meaning: past tense of write: put words on paper or a screen

yeast.meaning: a fungus used to make bread rise and beer ferment

yield.meaning: produce a result or crop; give way

zebra.meaning: an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes
zebra.example: a zebra crossing is named after it
